parameters.name: ProcessID
parameters.description: Process ID of the process that crashed.

parameters.name: ProcessName
parameters.description: Process Name of the process that crashed.

parameters.name: FaultLocation
parameters.description: Specifies the location of where to create and keep the process fault logs. Can either be a relative path or file within the {{param|#.StoragePath}} location.

parameters.name: TimeStamp
parameters.description: The time when the process fault occurred.

parameters.name: FirmwareVersion
parameters.description: The firmware version that triggered the process fault.

parameters.name: Arguments
parameters.description: The command arguments that were used to start to the process.

parameters.name: Reason
parameters.description: The reason why the process fault occurred.

object.description: Each table entry represents a process fault that is stored on the device.
